svg.title: A fictional library history made visible
svg.desc: A sentence changes from six to eight, a reference disappears, and text about free printing returns. These are computed observations from five fictional revisions.

g.text: What a history lets you see
Rivergate Library · fictional offline sample · computed by Refract's analyzers
Before: Rivergate Library is open until six every weekday throughout the year
After: Rivergate Library is open until eight every weekday throughout the year
The observation records removal; your application decides what it means.
The library provides free printing for all registered members
Previously observed wording is present again in the sample history.
Source inputs and complete event data are linked in the offline walkthrough.
